title: I-F Controller
text: Implement I-F control for a three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor, 7 inputs, 4 outputs, {Speed unit} sets Unit of the speed inputs; {Enable speed damping} sets the option to enable block to apply speed oscillation damping, {Use input port for computed parameters (run-time motor swap)} sets the option to enable input port to accept computed, {Number of pole pairs}, {Position unit} sets the unit of electrical, {Per unit speed (RPM)} sets the speed corresponding to one per-unit, {Current unit} sets the unit of motor currents, {Base current (A)} sets the nominal current corresponding to one, {Discrete step size (s)} sets the interval between consecutive block executions, {Speed to exit I-F controller (RPM), ω1}, {Speed to re-enter I-F controller (RPM), ω2} sets the speed required to re-enter I-F control, {Maximum current (A), Imax} sets the maximum motor current during I-F control, {Maximum rate of speed change (RPM/s)} sets the maximum rate of speed change during I-F, {Maximum current decay rate (A/s)} sets the maximum rate of current decay during I-F, {Idle time (s)} sets the time of constant speed and current, {Minimum allowed position error for transition (rad)} sets the threshold error for closed-loop transition, {Voltage unit} sets the unit of stator voltages, {Base voltage (V)} sets the nominal voltage corresponding to one and {Damping coefficient, ζ} sets the speed oscillation damping coefficient. Values come from the instance.
